title: QORA designs quantum control sequences that extend spin coherence in diamond
summary: In an arXiv preprint, Washington University in St. Louis researchers report that QORA designed AID-ROD-1, a sequence that nearly doubled measured coherence time relative to DROID-C3PO in a dense ensemble of spin-1 nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond. The agent system used simulation and laboratory feedback under human oversight. The research team subsequently analyzed the mechanisms behind the improvement. The comparison is specific to the tested ensemble, and independent replication was not established in the preprint.

evidence.tested: Direct laboratory comparison of measured coherence time with DROID-C3PO in the tested spin-1 ensemble in diamond.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and transfer to other platforms were not established in the reviewed preprint.
evidence.ai_role: QORA proposed, simulated and refined control sequences using data from automated experiments under human oversight. The researchers interpreted the mechanism.

source_review.scope: arXiv v1 abstract, methods and experimental results
